pages.text: Right-click a supported living mob with a scalpel to collect organic matter. Metal, diamond, and netherite scalpels provide 25, 150, and 300 durability. Collect several samples from the mob that carries your desired gene.

Supply NeoForge energy from a compatible generator or battery mod. Feed organic matter into the $(l:machines/cell_analyzer)Cell Analyzer$(), then process its cell in the $(l:machines/dna_extractor)DNA Extractor$(). Decode the helix in the $(l:machines/dna_decrypter)DNA Decrypter$().

Place a plasmid in the $(l:machines/plasmid_infuser)Plasmid Infuser$(). Start it with decoded DNA carrying the desired gene. Matching DNA adds 2 points; Basic DNA adds 1 after the plasmid is assigned. Fill it to 24 points by default. Twelve matching helices are enough.

Hold use with an empty syringe to take your own blood. Purify it in the $(l:machines/blood_purifier)Blood Purifier$(). Put the full plasmid and syringe into the $(l:machines/plasmid_injector)Plasmid Injector$(). Adding a gene contaminates blood again: purify it a second time.

Hold use with your purified, gene-bearing syringe to inject it. Drawing and injecting each take 32 ticks and cause 1 damage; injection adds 10 seconds of nausea. The syringe becomes empty. Your genes survive death and respawning.
